# Herdown Full Context

Herdown is a clean-data extraction product for AI workflows.

It focuses on:
- Web pages
- Documents
- Images and screenshots
- Markdown output
- JSON structured output
- Sitemap discovery

It is not trying to replace downstream knowledge base systems.

Recommended downstream tools:
- Dify
- Coze
- FastGPT
- n8n

Documentation:
- https://herdown.com/docs
- Website to Markdown: https://herdown.com/website-to-markdown
- HTML to Markdown: https://herdown.com/paste-to-markdown
- Blog: https://herdown.com/blog
- HTML to Markdown for AI guide: https://herdown.com/blog/how-to-convert-html-to-markdown-for-ai
- Best Markdown converter for AI agents: https://herdown.com/blog/best-markdown-converter-for-ai-agents
- Markdown for agents tools workflow: https://herdown.com/blog/markdown-for-agents-tools
- Quick start: paste a webpage URL on the homepage and convert it to Markdown.
- Single-page URL conversion is available at /url-to-markdown; multi-page domain, starting URL, and sitemap crawling is available at /website-to-markdown.
- REST API: create an API key and send it as a Bearer token to /v1/parse.
- MCP and CLI: use the API, MCP, CLI, or browser extension for AI workflow automation.
- Local files: use MarkItDown for text-based PDF, Word, PPT, and Excel files.
- OCR: use the local Unlimited-OCRSkill for screenshots, scans, invoices, and image files.
- Pricing: the free plan includes 1,000 parses per user per month. Paid credits are one-time purchases and do not auto-renew.
- Privacy: Herdown is a clean-materials generator, not a hosted knowledge base. Do not submit private content or content you are not allowed to process.

Core user promise:
- Take messy source material and turn it into clean material that AI tools can use directly.
